(2) The woman points to her left. A man wearing glasses and a black shirt enters the frame. The woman turns towards him and embraces him in a hug. She performs several quick, repetitive movements with her head as if kissing him on the cheek while he smiles with squinted eyes. (3) The woman turns back to face the camera with a large, joyful grin, placing her hand on her chest. She then turns her back to the camera and begins walking away towards the back of the terminal hall, showing the rear of her dress and bun hairstyle.
